QuestInfo.name: Meerkats Listen During the Day
QuestInfo.0: You should ask the Camel Cab for information about the Mushroom Castle.
QuestInfo.1: Apparently, Meerkats spread rumors like wildfire during the day. Defeat enough Meerkats in a limited amount of time to keep the rumor from spreading.\r\n
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Go on to the Scorpions Can't Listen at Night quest.\r\n

mob.0: Why are you coming back? Keep defeating Meerkats!
